title: Stage 1 prospective preregistration plan for PQID-Bench 2 semantic validity and family contrasts
study_objective: Prospectively test and quantify model-level Semantic Void, distinguish semantic failure from semantic-preserving structural divergence, and evaluate secondary algorithm-family, scope, and name-visibility contrasts.

registration.self_reference_note: OSF assigns the DOI after public submission; record it in a separately hashed registration receipt.
stage_2_required_before_api_calls: final eligible prompt panel and hashes
semantic targets and validated oracle implementations
activated contrasts and exact statistical specifications
analysis code commit and pretransmission checksums

required_fields: public OSF registration DOI in post-registration receipt
frozen prompt IDs and SHA-256 hashes
semantic-oracle implementation, control, tolerance, and environment hashes
sample-size and power or precision target

semantic_success.definition: One only when the extracted generated circuit satisfies the frozen task semantics under its preregistered semantic oracle; zero by convention when no circuit is available for semantic adjudication.

semantic_void.definition: E_i(f) * (1 - S_i(f)); a model-output state, not prompt ambiguity or structural nonmatch alone.

semantic_void_rate_execution_conditioned.definition: sum V_i_sem(f) divided by sum E_i(f) over the frozen semantically adjudicable panel.

semantic_void_rate_assembly_conditioned.definition: sum A_i(f) * (1 - S_i(f)) divided by sum A_i(f) over the same panel.

semantic_module.requirement: Prompt wording uniquely determines a task-level semantic acceptance criterion; multiple valid circuit structures may be admitted.

signature_module.requirement: Prompt wording additionally uniquely determines every component of the frozen reference-signature predicate.
signature_module.relation: T_sig is a subset of T_sem

prompt_eligibility.current_exception_interpretation: Prompt-specification exceptions, not observed Semantic Void cases; excluded from signature contrasts if retained and eligible for semantic analysis only after a prospective semantic-identifiability audit.

analysis_hierarchy: primary: PB2-SEM-01 semantic-void occurrence and prevalence
secondary: PB2-SEM-02 semantic decomposition of executable signature disagreement
secondary confirmatory: family, scope, and name-visibility contrasts

secondary.definition: sum(E_i(f) * (1 - M_i_sig(f)) * S_i(f)) divided by executable signature nonmatches over T_sig intersect T_sem
mean(E_i(f) - M_i_sig(f)) over the frozen signature-eligible panel
sum(E_i(f) * (1 - M_i_sig(f))) / sum(E_i(f)) over signature-identifiable eligible cells

analysis_contract.reference_equation: PQID-Bench 1 supplement Eq. (E.4), subject to a frozen PQID-Bench 2 semantic extension
analysis_contract.unit: prompt-level outcome count over the frozen model roster
analysis_contract.interval_method: crossed model-by-complete-target bootstrap, reported separately for semantic and signature outcomes
analysis_contract.multiplicity: The sole primary semantic estimand is outside the secondary contrast family. Holm correction applies separately within each frozen family, scope, and visibility contrast family, and semantic and signature outcome families are corrected separately. Stage 2 enumerates all activated contrasts before calls.

hypotheses.question: Does the model-level Semantic Void state E=1,S=0 occur on the frozen panel, and what is its prevalence?
hypotheses.decision_rule: Panel existence requires at least one independently confirmed V_i_sem(f)=1; any population-level claim requires the preregistered crossed-interval criterion.

hypotheses.question: How much executable signature disagreement is semantic-preserving structural divergence rather than Semantic Void?
hypotheses.decision_rule: Report a paired finite-panel decomposition and crossed model-by-target intervals without causal interpretation.

hypotheses.question: Does each semantic oracle discriminate valid alternatives from invalid circuits before model-output evaluation?
hypotheses.decision_rule: All preregistered oracle-stratum thresholds must pass before model calls; failed strata are reported as not estimable.

hypotheses.contrast: Family contrasts among Deutsch/Deutsch-Jozsa, Bernstein-Vazirani, Simon, and Grover within compact algorithm-style circuits.
hypotheses.activation_rule: all compared family cells satisfy preregistered eligibility and minimum-cell rules

hypotheses.contrast: Family contrasts within the common pre-oracle or opening-stage setup stratum.
hypotheses.activation_rule: scope mapping and eligible family cells are frozen before transmission
at least two families satisfy preregistered eligibility and minimum-cell rules; otherwise report not estimable

hypotheses.contrast: Family-by-scope interaction across the three frozen audited scope levels.
hypotheses.activation_rule: scope levels and minimum cell sizes are frozen before transmission

hypotheses.contrast: Robustness of family contrasts to explicit algorithm-name visibility using signature-identical visible and masked variants.
hypotheses.activation_rule: both variants remain equally identifiable and share the same frozen target signature

stage_2_operationalization_fields: final sample size and power or precision target
final prompt panel and prompt/target hashes
